item.title: Frontier Airlines Appoints New CEO
item.description: James Dempsey will be Frontier’s new CEO amid speculation that the carrier is once again interested in a merger with the beleaguered Spirit Airlines.

item.title: Lemon Tree Hotels Denies Report of Warburg Pincus Stake
item.description: Even as Lemon Tree Hotels shuts down talk of a Warburg Pincus deal, its asset-light model helps explain why investors keep circling. It offers a way to tap into India’s domestic travel boom without taking on full operational risk.

item.title: Skift Data + AI Summit 2026 Returns to New York City
item.description: AI now drives pricing, forecasting, and customer service across travel. The real challenge is not adoption, but governance, trust, and scaling without costly mistakes. That is the focus of the Skift Data + AI Summit 2026 in New York City.

item.title: Inside the Boeing 737 Factory Shaping the Pace of Airline Growth
item.description: After a prolonged period of crisis and scrutiny, Boeing says it is ready to grow again – but only at a pace dictated by discipline and regulators.

item.title: Wizz Air CEO Warns Ryanair’s O’Leary to ‘Think Twice’ as Rivalry Escalates
item.description: Europe’s low-cost airline rivalries can resemble a soap opera, with familiar characters and recurring insults. But beneath the theatrics lies a very real battle for market dominance and relevance.

item.title: Trump Wants to Ban Big Investors from Buying Homes. Would It Affect Short-Term Rentals?
item.description: Whether it's an executive order or legislation, any impact of a ban on institutional investors in the single-family home market would depend on the fine print.

item.title: Marriott Expands Loyalty Strategy With ICC Cricket Partnership
item.description: Loyalty can’t live only inside a hotel stay anymore, and Marriott has been acting on that idea for a while now. Cricket fits neatly into this strategy as fans plan trips, time off, and even family gatherings around tournaments, especially in markets like India, Australia, and the UK.

item.title: More International Growth and a Spirit Merger? What to Expect From Airline Earnings
item.description: In 2026, expect more of the same for the airline industry — analysts think the premium boom will most likely continue and the ultra-low-cost carriers could flounder.

item.title: Credit-Card Rewards Now Rival Airline and Hotel Loyalty Programs
item.description: Surveys by Skift Research across four major markets reveal shifting allegiances for loyalty programs, a widening confidence gaps among leisure travelers, and other trends for 2026.

item.title: Kayak CEO Tried to Take the Company Private: Scoop
item.description: There's no doubt that an independent and privately held Kayak, freed from the broader considerations of Booking Holdings, could have benefited from focused investment and attention.
